create_openai_client: create an OpenAI client configured with HuggingFace router base URL and HF_TOKEN API key
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion call to a vision-language model using the OpenAI Python SDK
build_multimodal_message: build a multimodal message with text and image_url content for a vision-language model
run_vlm_inference: run vision-language model inference on an image using Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct via Fireworks AI
read_completion_response: read the chat completion response and extract the assistant message from choices
